description: Janez Gregor Golja at the University of Ljubljana publishes electrical parameters for selected 20/0.4-kV distribution transformers in Ajdovščina, western Slovenia. The STREAM project deposit contains a CSV with rated apparent power, nominal high- and low-voltage levels, short-circuit voltage, its resistive component, iron losses and no-load current. Transformer labels are anonymised as TR1, TR2 and subsequent identifiers. The June 2026 release is free under CC BY 4.0. The selection size, equipment vintage and measurement uncertainty are not stated in the landing-page description. These parameters can initialise transformer models for local power-flow and capacity simulations. A separate Zenodo deposit supplies 2025 active- and reactive-power measurements using the same anonymised identities; it is linked here. No existing catalogue record explicitly covers these stations. Neither CSV contents nor consistency across the companion deposits was checked.
